name: 200mg | Grapefruit 2:1:1 CBG:CBC Sativa Enhanced Gummies
description:
Wyld's 2:1:1 THC:CBG:CBC + Sativa Enhanced Gummies offer a blissful + boosting nudge in the right direction. These gummies are a 2:1:1 ratio product featuring a balanced dose of three cannabinoids for an uplifting + energetic experience. Made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes, and natural flavors.

200mg THC:100mg CBG:100mg CBC per package, 20mg THC:10mg CBG:10mg CBC per gummy | 10 gummies per package.
